title: Model output: the terminology in one shipped string pair
description: What a terms call must return per item. Batched HTTP calls wrap items as { items: [{ key, ...this }] }. An empty list means the string has no product or domain terms.

source.description: The English term in its base form

target.description: The text the translation uses for it, copied verbatim. An empty term is set aside, not an error

base.description: Dictionary form of target in the locale

productMeaning.description: What the term means in this product, in a few words
